verses.1: And in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arphaxad, king of Elasar, and Sargon, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim.
verses.2: They fought against the evil king of Sodom, and against the evil king of Amorah, who was also the king of Adama. They also fought against the king of Zobim and the king of Bela Hizar.
verses.3: All of these people were located at the edge of the cliffs—that is, on the shore of the sea.
verses.4: They served Kedarleomer for twenty-two years, and then they rebelled for thirteen years.
verses.5: And in the forty-five years, Kedarlamer and the kings who were with him came. They healed those who were sick by using their magic powers. They also cured those who were injured and those who were possessed by demons.
verses.6: And the deer was hunted in its wild state, from a young deer up to a full-grown deer, which lived on the desert.
verses.7: And they returned and came to the place of judgment. It was a holy place. They destroyed all the enemies of Amalek, as well as those who lived in the land of Tamar.
verses.8: And he went out to fight against King Sodom, King Amorah, King Adma, King Zobai, and King Bela. They prepared to battle against him in the wilderness.
verses.9: These are: Kedarlamo, king of Eilam; Tidal, king of the nations; Amraphel, king of Shinar; and Arioch, king of Elasar. These four kings made up the “fives” mentioned in the Bible.
verses.10: And the steep cliffs stood along the paths. King Sodom and Amorah were destroyed. The people who remained were also killed.
verses.11: And they took all their possessions, including Sodom and Amorah. Then they left.
verses.12: And they took Lot and his possessions with them. They went away, and he remained in Sodom.
verses.13: And the exile came and reported to Abraham, the Hebrew man. He was living in the land of Mamre, near Ephron. His brothers were Esau and Aner. They were descendants of Abraham’s covenant with them.
verses.14: Abram heard that his brothers had died. He mourned for them. His relatives, who were from his own family, numbered twelve and three hundred. They went down to Dan.
verses.15: And he divided them up into groups, for himself and his servants. Then they pursued them all the way to Hovah, which is located near Damashq.
verses.16: And he restored all his possessions, along with his brother Lot. He also restored the women and the people.
verses.17: And he went out from Sodom to call upon them after his return from the battle against Kedarlamer and the kings who were with him. That place was called “Elmelek Shohay”.
verses.18: And the king of justice, King Shalem, brought out bread and wine. He was also a priest to the Lord.
verses.19: And He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abraham, may He who created heaven and earth bless him.”
verses.20: And blessed is Elion, who you have in your hand as a weapon against your enemies. He has given him twenty things from all of them.
verses.21: And the king of Sodom said to Abraham, “Give me the life force and the wealth. You may take whatever you want.”
verses.22: And Abraham said to King Sodom, “I have raised my hand before Jehovah, the Lord of heaven and earth.”
verses.23: Whether it’s during the day or at night, and whether I take away everything that belongs to you, do not say that I have taken over Abraham’s possessions.
verses.24: Only I, who was eaten by those boys, and a portion of the people who followed me to Enar Eschol, will take their share.
